Hartweik

Overview

Hartweik is the imperial officer who confronts Kir on Suslanger. He dismisses Kir’s papers, treats him as a slave and notices that his red skin resembles a description in a report about an attack on scholars. His interest in reporting Kir is openly tied to the prospect of a reward. [1]

Escape from Jigran

Kir, whose full name is Kir-A-Chit-La, is a young Joon enslaved under Firez on Jigran. He escapes the castle, leaving his family behind, and hopes to return with help. Outside the castle, a recruiter mistakes him for someone expected at the camp. Kir conceals his identity and accepts travel papers for work on Suslanger. The apparent opening to freedom instead delivers him to imperial authorities. Hartweik dismisses his papers, treats him as a slave and considers reporting the red-skinned stranger for a reward. [2, 1, 3, 4]
